source.author: verg
source.text: Illi haec inter se dubiis de rebus agebant certantes; castra Aeneas aciemque movebat:
source.text_original: Illi haec inter se dubiis de rebus agebant / certantes; castra Aeneas aciemque movebat: /
source.text_english: Meanwhile they were debating these uncertain matters among themselves, contending; Aeneas was moving the camp and drawing up his battle line.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ite, viri, mecum dubiisque evincite rebus, quae meminisse iuvet nostrisque nepotibus instent.
reuse.text_original: ite, viri, mecum dubiisque evincite rebus, / quae meminisse iuvet nostrisque nepotibus instent.
reuse.text_english: Go, men, with me, and overcome the doubtful circumstances, that it may be a pleasure to remember them and they may press upon our grandsons.
